_note: Country defaults applied at project setup. Each can be overridden in the project's config.json.
name: Australia
building_code: National Construction Code (NCC/BCA). The governing edition is the one in force when the building approval was applied for, with the State's variations - see codes/ncc/adoption-and-editions.md and codes/ncc/state-variations.md
payment_law: The security of payment Act of the State or Territory where the work is - see payment/README.md
safety_regime: The model WHS laws in every jurisdiction except Victoria, which runs the OHS Act 2004 - see safety/README.md

CC-BY-4.0.pattern: The National Construction Code\s+(\d{4})\s+was provided by the\s+Australian Building Codes Board under the CC BY 4\.0 licence
